info.title: VYLK backend API
info.description: HTTP contracts for native and browser clients. Read client-protocol.md before implementing offline sync or encryption. The release build replaces the documentation version with its selected tag; no server URL or credential is embedded.

post.description: Read bootstrap first. In legacy/preparing mode, send the configured server password. In encrypted/cleaning mode, omit password and send a derived proof or recovery_proof. Recovery proof takes precedence if both proofs are supplied. Limit: 16 KiB JSON. Preserve both response cookies in your cookie jar.

200.description: Signed in. Sets session and vylk-device cookies.

post.description: Revokes all sessions grouped under this device cookie, not just this tab. Keep encrypted pending edits locally; logout does not upload them.

204.description: Signed out; empty body. Clears session cookie.

get.description: Compare instance_id, vault_mode, and vault_epoch against persisted local state before resuming synchronization. revision is the application asset revision, not a note revision.
Tabs sharing a vylk-device cookie appear as one device. last_seen_at is approximate; activity updates are throttled. Entries are ordered by recent activity.

delete.description: Idempotent for an unknown but valid device ID. Revocation cannot erase plaintext or keys already held by an offline device. Disabled by VYLK_DISABLE_VAULT_CHANGES.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Device ID, not a sync queue device_id.

get.description: With limit, returns a page; without limit, returns an array and ignores cursor. Newest updated_at first. Plaintext tag filtering is exact; encrypted mode rejects tag with 409 client_search_required. Encrypted responses contain envelopes instead of title/tags/filename. The page response's nextCursor may be absent or empty at the end.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Enable pagination. An empty limit is invalid in encrypted mode.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding page; do not parse or invent it.

post.summary: Create or replace a complete note
post.description: Not a patch or text delta. Plaintext limit: 4 MiB JSON; encrypted limit: 8 MiB. Plaintext id may be omitted to generate an ID; supplying an ID requires base_revision (0 for a new note). Encrypted mode requires a client-generated ID, base_revision, epoch, summary, and body. Responses omit content/body. For offline clients prefer ordered sync/push, which supports replay acknowledgements and an instance fence.

409.description: note_revision_conflict or stale_vault_epoch. Plaintext revision conflicts include note_id and current_revision; encrypted direct conflicts may contain only error/code.

200.description: Metadata and Markdown content, or summary/body envelopes in encrypted mode.

delete.summary: Delete a note at a known revision
delete.description: Revision-checked deletion; not an unconditional idempotent delete. A repeat request may return conflict or not-found. Offline clients should use sync/push.

get.description: Title/tag prefix search, not body search. Uses at most the first eight whitespace-separated terms, combined with AND; returns up to 50 ranked summaries. An empty query returns []; no matches for a nonempty query can return null. Encrypted mode returns 409 client_search_required; decrypt and search locally.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed search text, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

200.description: Ranked plaintext note summaries or null.

get.description: Encrypted mode returns 409 client_search_required. Build its tag index from decrypted summaries locally.

get.summary: Read the durable note change feed
get.description: since is exclusive. Store nextSequence only after committing the fetched changes locally. Follow hasMore; when false, stop fetching until a new hint/poll. resetRequired means the retained feed no longer covers the cursor: rebuild a snapshot without deleting pending edits. instance_id distinguishes replacement databases; do not infer identity from a cursor. See the protocol guide for snapshot races and reset handling.

200.description: Ordered changes, tombstones, cursor and server identity.

get.summary: Fetch complete notes in a small batch
get.description: Up to 25 comma-separated IDs, counted before deduplication. Empty ids returns empty notes/missing arrays. A fetched revision may be newer than the change-feed entry; do not overwrite pending local edits.

200.description: Existing complete notes and missing IDs.

post.description: At most 100 operations; 4 MiB plaintext or 8 MiB encrypted JSON. Empty operations is allowed to read expected_sequence. Full-note saves, not text deltas. Sequence starts at 1 and is contiguous per device_id; preserve it and stable op_id across retries. Conflicts consume sequence numbers. A 409 sequence gap can acknowledge an already-committed prefix. Timeouts/5xx can also follow partial commits: retry the identical operations. Do not interpret every HTTP 200 as every operation applied. See the protocol guide.

parameters.name: X-Vylk-Instance-ID
parameters.description: Strongly recommended: persisted server instance_id. A mismatch returns 409 before any writes. Omission is accepted for compatibility, not safe for offline replacement-database recovery.

400.description: invalid_sync_request, invalid_sync_operation or invalid_encrypted_operation. Plaintext invalid_sync_operation includes permanent=true, operation_index, client_sequence and op_id.

409.description: Sequence gap (PushResult), invalid_replayed_operation, server_instance_changed, or stale_vault_epoch (Error, possibly epoch). A changed server requires a user decision; never silently renumber/re-upload pending edits.

get.summary: Subscribe to change and session hints
get.description: Server-Sent Events, not a durable feed. Starts with retry: 3000, server and heartbeat events; heartbeats every 25 seconds. change events hint notes/preferences; session-expired closes the connection. No event IDs or Last-Event-ID replay. Reconnect with cookies and perform a durable pull after hints/reconnect. Plain-text 500 is possible before stream setup.
Preferences are not encrypted. Read revision from JSON; no ETag is emitted.

patch.description: Despite PATCH, this is full replacement, not a partial merge. Read, modify, and send the complete object with If-Match. Missing fields can reset settings. Limit: 16 KiB JSON. _sync_patch/_sync_base only implement partial merging in sync prefs.save; this endpoint ignores those helpers.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Positive revision, plain or quoted. Missing or * permits unconditional replacement; avoid this in multi-device clients.

get.summary: Discover vault mode and derivation settings
get.description: Public, no key wrappers. In legacy mode vault_id, epoch, and kdf are absent. reset_available does not override VYLK_DISABLE_VAULT_CHANGES; the reset API can still reject the operation.

200.description: Current encryption mode and public KDF settings.
Decrypt locally using the appropriate derived wrapping key.

post.description: Limit: 32 KiB. Rewrap the SAME vault key; do not replace it. master requires fresh KDF parameters and updates the login proof; recovery updates the recovery proof/wrapper. current_recovery chooses which old proof authorizes the action, independent of kind. Always revokes the current session; sign_out_other_devices defaults true for either kind. Success requires a new login. Does not rotate the note key, vault ID, or epoch.

Optional recovery-from-total-key-loss operation, NOT passphrase recovery or decryption. Requires configured VYLK_PASSWORD in the body, not a session/proof. Limit: 32 KiB. Archives the old database/ciphertext for 30 days, then replaces credentials, clears notes/feed/queue counters and revokes all sessions. Returns a new session. The old data still needs its old key. instance_id remains unchanged; vault_id changes and epoch increments. Confirm data-loss consequences before calling. Do not retry an ambiguous reset blindly.

200.description: New empty vault and new session.

post.description: Limit: 32 KiB. Requires old_password even with a session. Generate a random vault key/ID and both credential wrappers locally. Creates a consistent backup and pauses plaintext writes. Repeating the same vault_id resumes setup; it does not replace previously stored credentials. Preserve the original setup secrets until commit. No abort or disable-encryption API exists.

507.description: migration_backup_failed: free storage and retry same setup.

get.description: Up to 100 notes in lexicographic ID order. Empty array means no remaining unverified notes. A source revision change invalidates its previous verification.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last ID from the preceding page, exclusive. This is an ID, not a notes-page cursor.

post.summary: Stage an encrypted copy of a source note
post.description: Limit: 8 MiB. Source revision must match. Restaging clears its verification. Fetch and decrypt the staged copy before verifying it.

200.description: Staged copy. body_hash is SHA-256 of exact stored envelope JSON bytes, not decrypted Markdown or reserialized JSON.

post.summary: Acknowledge client verification of a staged note
post.description: Limit: 4 KiB. First decrypt the downloaded staged summary/body and compare them with the source. The server only checks the stored hash and source revision; it cannot verify decryption. Send the body_hash returned by staged/{id}.

post.summary: Commit verified encrypted notes and remove plaintext
post.description: No body required. Requires backup and all source notes verified. Revokes all sessions; log in with the derived proof afterward. Note queue counters survive migration; do not restart sequence at 1. If vault_cleanup_pending returns 500, encrypted cutover already succeeded; cleanup resumes on server restart. Do not revert to plaintext or start a new setup.

session.name: session
session.description: Opaque session cookie obtained from login. Native clients must retain a cookie jar; Bearer authentication is not supported.

VaultProtocol.name: X-Vylk-Vault-Protocol
VaultProtocol.description: Required value 1 for this route in encrypted mode; otherwise 426. Not required for authentication, preferences, keys, migration, or SSE.

Cookies.description: May contain multiple Set-Cookie lines. session is HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, 180-day lifetime; vylk-device groups browser-profile sessions and lasts 365 days. Secure is set for HTTPS. Authenticated activity periodically renews session. Never combine Set-Cookie lines with commas.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed, oversized, unknown-field, or invalid request (invalid_request or a route-specific code). JSON body limits return 400, not 413.

Unauthorized.description: authentication_required for a missing, expired, or revoked session; credential endpoints can return invalid_credentials.

RateLimited.description: login_rate_limited. Wait retry_after seconds; do not hammer credentials.

VaultChangesDisabled.description: vault_changes_disabled: server policy rejects vault/device mutations. Ordinary notes and preferences remain usable.

ClientSearch.description: client_search_required: decrypt summaries and search/filter/index tags locally.

Locked.description: vault_migration_in_progress (writes during preparation), vault_maintenance_in_progress (cleaning), or vault_unavailable. Pause writes; do not discard pending changes.

ProtocolRequired.description: encrypted_client_required: set X-Vylk-Vault-Protocol: 1 and implement the encrypted contract; never retry a plaintext body as encrypted.

RecoveryBlocked.description: Pending file recovery prevents writes. Retain operations and retry with backoff after recovery; code depends on route (note_file_recovery_blocked, note_recovery_pending, note_recovery_failed).

MigrationConflict.description: Migration state/source mismatch: vault_migration_not_started, vault_migration_not_ready, vault_note_changed, vault_verify_mismatch, vault_migration_incomplete, or unexpected_note_files. Inspect state before retrying.

ServerError.description: Storage/internal failure with a route-specific code. Some writes may already have committed; reconcile rather than assuming nothing changed.

VaultID.description: 16 random bytes, unpadded strict base64url (22 characters).

Proof.description: 32 derived bytes, unpadded strict base64url (43 characters). Reusable authentication secret; never log it or send SHA-256(proof) instead.

Envelope.description: AES-256-GCM envelope, an object rather than a JSON-encoded string. Nonce: 12 bytes. Ciphertext includes the final 16-byte authentication tag. Both are strict unpadded base64url. Summary envelope JSON is limited to 37,888 bytes.

error.description: Human-readable message; branch on code instead.

title.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes on save.

filename.description: Storage name; not an API path.

tags.description: Comma-separated, trimmed and deduplicated, case-sensitive; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes in a save request.

base_revision.description: Required when id is supplied; 0 creates a new client-generated ID.

Operation.description: Conditional fields: save needs note_id/base_revision and complete title/tags/content; delete needs note_id/base_revision >= 1; pin needs note_id/base_revision >= 0/pinned; prefs.save needs prefs and preferably base_revision; noop only needs sequence/op_id/type. base_content is accepted but does not cause server-side text merging. Existing note pin state changes through note.pin.

EncryptedOperation.description: save requires note_id/base_revision/summary/body/epoch; delete and pin require note_id/base_revision/epoch (and pinned for pin). prefs.save and noop do not require epoch. Plaintext title/tags/content/base_content fields are rejected. Envelope AAD binds epoch; do not change it without re-encrypting.

status.description: All consume sequence. compacted acknowledges an old consumed operation whose detailed result was pruned, not proof that remote content matches.

ShortcutStep.description: First step modifiers are [Mod] or [Mod, Shift]; second step modifiers must be empty.

FontSize.description: Empty is accepted in full replacement; a sync patch must use a listed nonempty size.

ContentWidth.description: Empty is accepted in full replacement; a sync patch must use a listed nonempty width.

Preferences.description: Account-wide unencrypted UI settings. For sync partial updates, supply _sync_patch (desired fields) and _sync_base (previous values of those fields) with the operation base_revision; stale changes merge only when each current field equals the base or desired value. Defaults documented here apply to a fresh account, not every omitted field in PATCH.

theme.description: Built-in theme name or client-defined palette string; server stores it without interpreting the palette.
